opening.quote: Good afternoon, Tidewell homes, my name Joost.
opening.comment: The agent gave a greeting, company name and own name, so the opening criterion is met even though the wording was garbled.

verification.quote: could I tick your full names and order number or post code?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and order number or postcode before discussing the order, which satisfies verification, though the caller gave only a first name and the agent did not confirm the surname.

understanding.quote: So nothing has arrived at all?
understanding.comment: The agent confirmed the actual issue, a parcel not arriving, and did not ask for information already given.

resolution_accuracy.quote: I can see order 560294, a set of plates at €54.08, still in after the 11 working daze.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent misread the order number (580294 given by the caller) and said 11 working days when the caller said 17, and the lost-parcel timeline was stated correctly only in part, so the facts were not accurately stated.

process_compliance.quote: Can so I put your on hold far a minute while I check with uh the courier?
process_compliance.comment: The agent asked permission before placing the caller on hold and thanked them on return, so the hold steps were followed.

communication.quote: I'm rally sorry, 11 this is far toos long wait, I'd be fed ups too.
communication.comment: The agent acknowledged the caller's frustration and apologised, and stayed polite throughout.

closing.quote: get email a day it closes. uh Is there anything else I could help with to say?
closing.comment: The agent explained next steps and asked if anything else was needed, though the email confirmation was hard to follow and the replacement timeline was not restated clearly.
